entities.name: First Temple (Solomon's Temple)
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The central sanctuary of Israelite worship, built by Solomon on Mount Moriah in Jerusalem (c. 957 BCE). Housed the Ark of the Covenant in the Holy of Holies. Destroyed by Nebuchadnezzar in 586 BCE, its loss catalyzed the transformation of Israelite religion.
